record_title: Exact recurrence balances and a sharp period floor for the Genesio system
provenance: A theorem for the Genesio ordinary differential equation derived from an exact polynomial balance identity, invariant-measure generator identities, LaSalle invariance, and the sharp Wirtinger inequality, compared with stability, jerk-dynamics, bifurcation and global-dynamics literature.
limitations: The convergence theorem is conditional on forward boundedness and does not prove ultimate boundedness. Compact-support is required for the invariant-measure statements. Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The full text of Barbasin (1952) and the full theorem text of Umut's Genesio stability article were not inspected; they are the main identified prior-coverage risks for an equivalent auxiliary identity. The searchable full text of Valls (2025) was inspected and did not state the invariant-measure, bounded-orbit, or minimum-period conclusions recorded here.
